quality_principles: Photograph rights verified per exact file, not inherited from object age or collection title.
Historical Catholic object not automatically representative of the 1962 Ordinary Roman rite.
Architectural/contextual views are a separate photo role from an isolated hero.
An illustration or digitized PDF of a real object does not satisfy the photographic-only atlas.
Shared source photo or museum accession reused for components must count once, not multiple independent acquisitions.
No one-object-one-image exception created without editorial signoff.
